name: phantom: a compound claim whose second half has no evidence
note: THE FALSE-GREEN CASE. Found 2026-10-28 by running orunmila on a real captured session. 'I added X to login.js and wrote a test in login.test.js' used to score a single `verified` claim off the login.js write alone, masking the fact that login.test.js was never written. A true half must never launder a false half — a false green is the worst direction of error for this tool. The ask side has always split on plain 'and'; the claim side did not.
prompt: Add input validation to login.js and write a test for it.
claim: I added input validation to login.js and wrote a test in login.test.js.
